original_card.question: Can a template or call contract leave two or more unpaid coordinates per live family?
methods: State a replacement for the coverage identity (mass = 72W + 64N) and the contract change that realizes it, with its implementation cost.
Find an obstruction: show which data-endpoint obligation forces exactly one unpaid coordinate in the current template.
original_card.acceptance_gate: An explicit replacement identity, verified on a small complete instance with dirty inputs, priced with ceiling.ceiling(unpaid=...). A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Explain where the single unpaid coordinate per family comes from in the hosted template; propose one change and price it. Ideal budget: two unpaid coordinates per family is 3.77x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: The deficit is one coordinate per family minus the centre charge; doubling unpaid coordinates per family scales it directly.
allowed_variations: One template change or one endpoint-contract change.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Counting a coordinate as unpaid while leaving it unadvanced in the data endpoint.

Continuing a partial cost improvement while leaving the same unpriced consumer, restoration or central-readout obligation unresolved; refresh the family expansion decision first. Local product-retiming evidence has a narrow scope and is not a ban on changed graphs or contracts.

actual_scope: For every nonempty S,T subset of a four-channel block with S union T equal to the block, classify and price all rational rank-one updates G=I+uv^T with supp(u)=S and supp(v)=T on the exact PR3335 rank-34 P112 factorization.
scope_change_reason: The original coverage-law task was redirected to the exact PR3335 factorization after rational pair, triple and cycle-word screens found no descent. A full-support rank-one pilot found 87 support pairs with minimum invoice 228. Because that dense saturation cannot represent asymmetric rectangular source/reader supports, the bounded question was expanded to every nonempty left/right support pattern whose union is four channels; this completes the rank-one update family on that block without claiming arbitrary GL4.
bottleneck_link: A strict tariff decrease is a necessary algebraic step toward the inherited optimistic 160 copy-screen allowance. This package tests whether any four-channel rank-one update can lower 224; it does not establish physical realization or change selected kappa.
stop_rule: Stop after exact affine-hyperplane classification of all 1,294 support/diagonal-flag cells, explicit rational witnesses for all feasible support pairs, pricing every distinct pair on all 46,376 channel quadruples, and dense scalar-identity/wrong-inverse controls. Do not infer a bound for rank-two updates, arbitrary GL4(Q), sequences, other factorizations or suppliers.
evidence: CERTIFICATE.json and RESULT.json; 79 support-membership patterns, 1,294 rational parameter cells (373 feasible, 921 exactly obstructed), 365 distinct support pairs, 16,927,240 pair/quadruple tariff cases, no strict improvement and minimum invoice 224. The full-support subset has 87 maps and minimum invoice 228.
author: OpenAI Codex
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in the diagonal-similarity normalization, exact affine-cell classifier, witness construction, tariff census and validation. No subagents, independent human review, formal proof assistant or OR-Tools were used.

open_questions.question: Can a rank-two Woodbury update G=I+UV^T on four channels lower the invoice?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The complete rank-one family has no descent, while rank-two updates introduce coupled two-dimensional source/reader mixing not representable by a single rank-one update.
open_questions.first_step: Derive exact matrix/inverse support constraints for U,V in Q^(4x2), classify one bounded nondegenerate support stratum, and price it on all channel quadruples before widening.
open_questions.blocked_by: The inverse now depends on a 2x2 Woodbury core and several coupled minors; a coefficient alphabet would not classify rational cancellations. Even a lower tariff would still need physical realization, dirty-state restoration and supplier admission.

boundary.source: The authenticated 112 selected P112 ports, exact PR3335 matching and 34 disjoint scalar supports, with K=A A^T.
boundary.operation: On any four of the 34 latent channels, choose nonempty S,T whose union is the block, rational vectors u,v with exactly those supports, and G=I+uv^T with 1+v^T u nonzero. Transform the source columns by G and reader rows by G^-1.
boundary.preserved: The complete rational 112x112 fitting matrix K and its scalar endpoint.
boundary.priced: For every changed term, the exact F2 pairing rank between complete source-plane and reader-plane spans, counting every occurrence.
boundary.not_supplied: Rank-two or arbitrary GL4 gauges, sequences of updates, other scalar factorizations, native implementation, dirty-helper restoration, physical consumer or supplier admission.

proved: Diagonal similarity normalizes every rank-one update with fixed supports S,T to u_i=1 on S and v_j=1 on T\S; only nonzero rational products x_i remain on S intersect T.

The source/inverse diagonal cancellations reduce to x_i=-1 and 1+sum_{j!=i}x_j=0 on the overlap; all 1,294 support/flag cells are classified by exact rational equation solving and finite hyperplane avoidance or obstruction.
The 373 feasible cells realize 365 distinct rational matrix/inverse support pairs with exact witnesses and checked inverses.
All 365 support pairs are priced on all 46,376 quadruples: 16,927,240 cases; every quadruple minimum is unchanged and no strict invoice improvement occurs.
The full-support subfamily independently retains minimum invoice 228 across its 87 support pairs.
Every representative exactly preserves all 12,544 scalar fitting entries; a wrong inverse is rejected.
unknown: Whether rank-two updates, non-rank-one arbitrary GL4(Q) matrices, longer sequences or other factorizations lower the invoice.
Whether a lower-tariff factorization has a legal physical decoder and complete supplier.
obligation_ledger.not_zero_cost_claim: This is an algebraic full-plane tariff screen only; physical gathering, restoration, chronology, consumers, precision, compilation and supplier costs remain unpriced.
